x:c.x:v: v2 CABLE SHORT-CIRCUIT THERMAL WITHSTAND — ADIABATIC CHECK

Checks I²t thermal withstand using I²t ≤ k²S². Exact/verified cable insulation is used when available; otherwise a verified planning-key insulation class may support screening. When the project fault input is PEAK kA, the module uses Peak/√2 as a conservative upper bound for RMS symmetrical current. Final k remains review-gated whenever the supported initial-temperature basis is not established.

Source boundary: ABB's electrical-installation handbook gives the adiabatic cable relation and representative k values for Cu/Al with PVC, EPR/XLPE and rubber insulation. Automatic k is used only when the conductor temperature rating does not exceed the source table's stated initial-temperature basis. Otherwise the workbook requires a source-backed manual k. If the project input is peak current only, this thermal module does not reverse-convert it to RMS; enter the RMS symmetrical fault value from the short-circuit study.
